fields.description: 8-byte ASCII header magic 'ROCKFOL0' copied from the ROM magic table to save-buffer offset 0 during finalization.
fields.evidence: FUN_0805621c copies 8 bytes from the ROM magic table (_DAT_08056254) to param_1+0 (func_0x0805ba74(param_1,uVar4,8)); FUN_080566a4 finalizes the header buffer (*(cfg+0x38)) with FUN_0805621c(mode 0) and writes 0x80 bytes via FUN_08055c94(mode 0) using size *(cfg+0x30)=0x80 set in FUN_080561d8. Baseline logical bytes [0x00..0x07] read 'ROCKFOL0'.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: Header u16 at save offset 8 that selects the EEPROM base for the 0x80-byte header: 0 selects blocks 0..15 (file bytes 0x00..0x7F), any nonzero value selects blocks 16..31.
fields.evidence: FUN_0805670c(param_1==0) loads u16 from header-buffer offset 8 (*(u16*)(*(cfg+0x38)+8)) and returns EEPROM base 0x00 when it is zero, 0x10 otherwise (uVar1=(-v|v)>>0x1f&0x10); FUN_080566a4 passes that base to FUN_08055c94 for the header write. Baseline value is 0, matching the header observed at file bytes 0x00..0x7F.
fields.name: slot_select

fields.description: 48-byte persisted runtime game state. Copied as a unit between the work area and save-buffer offset 10; exact per-byte gameplay meaning (stages/items/options) is not statically resolved in the decompanied caller graph.
fields.evidence: FUN_0805621c(mode 0) copies 0x30 bytes from the work area (*(cfg+0x50)) to param_1+10 for the file; FUN_08055624 copies header-buffer bytes [10..0x40) back into the work area (*(cfg+0x50)) after a valid main-region load (func_0x0805ba74(dst,src+10,0x30)). Covered by header_checksum. Baseline is all zeros (fresh formatted save).
fields.name: progress_block

fields.description: 68 bytes never written by the save finalizer but covered by the header checksum; zeros in the baseline formatted save.
fields.evidence: FUN_0805621c(mode 0) writes magic [0..8), payload [10..0x40), checksum [0x7E] and marker [0x7F] but never stores to [0x3A..0x7D); FUN_08056788 checksums bytes [0..0x7E) including this span (size *(cfg+0x30)=0x80 from FUN_080561d8, checksum at size-2). Baseline span is all zeros.
fields.name: reserved_pad

fields.description: Constant 0x88 format marker stored at the last byte of the 0x80-byte header on every finalize; not covered by the checksum.
fields.evidence: FUN_0805621c unconditionally stores 0x88 at param_1+(size-1) (pbVar8[1]=0x88 with iVar7=*(cfg+0x30)-2=0x7E, i.e. byte 0x7F); FUN_08056788 only verifies byte [size-2]. Baseline byte 0x7F is 0x88.
fields.name: format_marker

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'ROCKFOL0' header magic at logical offset 0
